description: Implementation of logging functions for TextToSpeech service, including integration with RDK logger and fallback to printf-based logging, with environment-based configuration and timestamping.

methods.name: sync_stdout
methods.description: Configures stdout buffering if environment variable 'SYNC_STDOUT' is set.

methods.name: methodName
methods.description: Extracts method name from a pretty function string.

methods.name: logger_init
methods.description: Initializes the logger, setting up stdout sync and environment-based log level or RDK logger initialization.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages with different levels, formats, and optional thread ID, either via RDK logger or printf, with timestamp and process info.
